pyq_bad.why: garbled options (truncated codes, stray PMF IAS text)

patterns: Exam asks one-line identification: founder of a platform (Twitter = Jack Dorsey, Facebook = Zuckerberg), professional network = LinkedIn.
Full forms and basics: E-mail, SIM, QR code, video-conferencing components (telephone is not essential).
APPSC repeats software/media items: FCP = video production, podcast, e-journals, hashtag on Twitter.
E-commerce asked as model classification (Amazon/Flipkart = B2C).
App goes far deeper into rules/acts and current-affairs statement items (IT Rules sections, Online Gaming Act, state bans) than any PYQ.
